# PDFCraft Pro

> PDFCraft Pro is an open-source, client-side document workstation featuring 35 professional PDF manipulation, conversion, OCR, and editing tools running 100% in-browser via WebAssembly. Zero files are uploaded to any server.

## Canonical URLs
- [Production Workstation](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/)
- [Custom Domain Portal](https://pdfcraft-pro.is-a.dev/)

## Core Privacy & Architecture
- [Client-Side Privacy](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/#privacy): All cryptographic operations, conversions, rendering, and parsing happen locally in user browser memory.
- [WebAssembly Performance](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/#wasm): High-performance PDF processing powered by compiled WebAssembly modules (pdf-lib, PDF.js, Tesseract.js OCR, SheetJS).
- [Zero Cost & Unlimited Access](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/#features): Completely free with zero subscriptions, paywalls, or document quotas.

## Primary PDF Tools
- [Merge PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/merge-pdf): Combine multiple PDF documents in custom sequence.
- [Split PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/split-pdf): Separate pages, ranges, or extract selected sheets into standalone PDFs.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/compress-pdf): Optimize and reduce PDF file size with extreme, recommended, or low compression.
- [PDF to Word](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-word): Convert PDF to editable Word DOCX format.
- [Word to PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/word-to-pdf): Convert DOCX and DOC documents into standardized PDF.
- [PDF to Excel](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-excel): Extract tabular data and numbers into spreadsheet XLSX or CSV.
- [Excel to PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/excel-to-pdf): Convert spreadsheets to paginated PDF reports.
- [PDF to PowerPoint](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-powerpoint): Convert slides and presentations to PPTX.
- [PowerPoint to PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/powerpoint-to-pdf): Render slide decks into vector PDF.
- [Edit PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/edit-pdf): Add text, callouts, shapes, and annotations directly to pages.
- [Sign PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/sign-pdf): Draw, stamp, and apply electronic signatures securely.
- [Watermark PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/watermark-pdf): Stamp custom text, timestamps, or image watermarks with opacity controls.
- [Rotate PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/rotate-pdf): Permanently adjust page orientation (90, 180, 270 degrees).
- [Protect PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/protect-pdf): Encrypt documents with AES passwords.
- [Unlock PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/unlock-pdf): Remove password security restrictions from authorized files.
- [OCR PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/ocr-pdf): Optical character recognition to convert scanned documents to searchable text.
- [Compare PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/compare-pdf): Visual side-by-side diffing between document versions.
- [Redact PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/redact-pdf): Permanently sanitize and black out sensitive data and PII.
- [Scan to PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/scan-to-pdf): Capture paper documents using web camera and compile into multi-page PDF.
- [AI Summarizer](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/ai-summarizer): Extract key takeaways and executive summaries from long reports.
- [Translate PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/translate-pdf): In-browser multilingual translation preserving document layout.
- [Flatten PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/flatten-pdf): Bake form fields and annotations into static print-ready layers.
- [PDF to PDF/A](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-pdfa): Standardize documents into ISO-compliant long-term archival format.
- [Organize PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/organize-pdf): Reorder, rotate, duplicate, or delete PDF pages visually.
- [PDF to Markdown](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/pdf-to-markdown): Extract clean Markdown text for notes and LLM prompts.
- [Markdown to PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/markdown-to-pdf): Render Markdown documents into styled PDF reports.
- [Crop PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/crop-pdf): Trim margins and custom crop rectangular page regions.
- [Repair PDF](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/tools/repair-pdf): Rebuild broken xref tables and recover damaged PDF streams.

## Optional Reference
- [Full Documentation](https://pdfcraft-pro.vercel.app/llms-full.txt): Detailed specifications of all 35 document transformation pipelines.
